title: Wedge-Shaped
summary: WEDGE-SHAPED, adjective [wedge and shape.] Having the shape of a wedge; cuneiform. A wedge-shaped leaf is broad and abrupt at the summit, and tapering down to the base.

inlines.v: WEDGE-SHAPED, adjective [wedge and shape.] Having the shape of a wedge; cuneiform. A wedge-shaped leaf is broad and abrupt at the summit, and tapering down to the base.
